derivation: SVG geometry: O=(195,13); wall top surface y=69 (x 11..137), corner (137,69), vertical face x=137 (y 69..165).
A lands on wall top at (117,69): dx=78, drop=56. B hits vertical face at (137,84): dx=58, drop=71.
Both paths are quadratic Beziers with control point at (mid-x, y0) -> horizontal initial tangent, x linear in t, y quadratic in t = true projectile parabolas.
t depends only on drop: drop_B > drop_A (B lands below the corner level where A lands) -> t_A < t_B (②).
v = dx/t: dx_A > dx_B and t_A < t_B -> v_A > v_B (③). Numeric check v_A ∝ 78/√56 ≈ 10.4, v_B ∝ 58/√71 ≈ 6.9.
Consistency: A at x=137 is at y≈44 (<69), so A clears the corner and lands on the top; B reaches x=137 at y=84 (below top) so it hits the face. ②③ -> option B.
uncertainties: None for the answer. Qualitative relations hold for any figure where A lands on the top surface left of the corner and B on the face below the corner.
Cosmetic: last visible dash of A stops ~8 px (≈1.3 viewBox units) above the wall top (falls in a dash gap); B's last dash is a short stub that does touch the face. Not answer-affecting.

derivation: Legend: large white = C, large hatched = O, small white = H.
Before: 1 CH4 (C + 4H) + 3 O2. After: 1 CO2 (O-C-O) + 2 H2O + 1 O2.
O2 appears on both sides -> 1 O2 unreacted; actual reaction CH4 + 2O2 -> CO2 + 2H2O (atoms: C1 H4 O6 before = C1 H4 O6 after, incl. leftover O2).
A wrong: molecule kinds change (CH4,O2 -> CO2,H2O); molecule count 4->4 (or 3->3 for reacting) but '种类、数目均不变' fails on kinds.
B wrong: reacting ratio CH4:O2 = 1:2, not 1:3 (1:3 is the charged ratio, a trap).
C correct: elemental O2 takes part; C -4 -> +4, O 0 -> -2: oxidation-reduction.
D wrong: products are only CO2 and H2O (2 kinds); leftover O2 is not generated.
uncertainties: Relies on the standard convention that a molecule present before and after is excess reactant; the figure follows it cleanly.
Option C uses a high-school concept (氧化还原); acceptable for 广东 科学推理.
